manifest.purpose: Section 5 paper-facing COMP-001 vs COMP-002 demonstration

cross_scenario_matrix.interpretation: Predictive conditions are comparable and do not alone explain the recommendation divergence.
The operational context starts to separate the scenarios.
Resource feasibility is a major source of divergence.
Both require human review, but only COMP-002 requires escalation.
The main divergence begins at contextualization.

cross_scenario_matrix.comp_002: Deferred intervention, enhanced monitoring, and escalation.
cross_scenario_matrix.interpretation: Similar prediction does not imply similar recommendation.
